create_BijectorFromTFP: create a BijectorFromTFP wrapper to use a TFP bijector as a Distrax bijector
forward_BijectorFromTFP: compute the forward transformation y=f(x) using a wrapped TFP bijector
inverse_BijectorFromTFP: compute the inverse transformation x=f inverse(y) using a wrapped TFP bijector
forward_and_log_det_BijectorFromTFP: compute the forward transformation and its log determinant of the Jacobian together
inverse_and_log_det_BijectorFromTFP: compute the inverse transformation and its log determinant of the Jacobian together
